title: Workshop Tool Utilization by Project
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), Klipper resonance metrics (`klipper:telemetry`), resin print logs (`resinprint:job`), tool usage (`tool:usage`), filament inventory (`filament:spool`), and workshop air readings (`workshop:air`).
app: Maker telemetry from OctoPrint, Moonraker, printer firmware sensors, resin printer job logs, smart dryboxes, and workshop tool sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tool:usage
| stats sum(minutes_used) as minutes_used by tool project
| sort - minutes_used
description: Summarises how much each major tool was used on each project so build effort is easier to estimate and compare.
value: Tool-time patterns help hobby projects feel less fuzzy by showing where time really went and which tools deserve maintenance priority.
implementation: Capture smart-plug runtime or manual project tags for saws, sanders, soldering stations, and other bench tools.
visualization: Treemap of total tool minutes by project.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which tools you used most on each project, so the time and effort behind your builds is easier to understand.
